definition: A specialization of MLOps focused specifically on the operational challenges of deploying and maintaining large language model applications, such as prompt versioning, evaluation, and cost monitoring.
details: LLMOps addresses concerns distinct from traditional MLOps, including prompt engineering workflows, retrieval pipeline management, token-cost tracking, and evaluation of open-ended generative outputs.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. In plain words: A specialization of MLOps focused specifically on the operational challenges of deploying and maintaining large language model applications, such as prompt versioning, evaluation, and cost monitoring. Here is how it actually plays out: LLMOps addresses concerns distinct from traditional MLOps, including prompt engineering workflows, retrieval pipeline management, token-cost tracking, and evaluation of open-ended generative outputs. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is LLMOps.
